scripts.build:esm: tsc -p tsconfig.json && mkdir -p dist/generated && cp src/generated/screamer.mjs dist/generated/screamer.mjs
scripts.build:cjs: tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && mkdir -p dist/cjs/generated && cp src/generated/screamer.mjs dist/cjs/generated/screamer.mjs && printf '{"type":"commonjs"}\n' > dist/cjs/package.json && printf 'module.exports = require("./index.js");\n' > dist/cjs/index.cjs
scripts.build: npm run build:esm && npm run build:cjs
scripts.prepack: npm run build:wasm:single && npm run build
